theorems.statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn p) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ V → ψ u ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)
